audit_corrections: Follow exact source identities in uvek_market_handovers, including xxx Diesel, at regional storage. The first prefix-only probe incorrectly classified agricultural diesel as disconnected; no runtime mapping change was needed.
interpretation: This inventory-path audit covers four fuel families in retained native source records; it is not complete IAM-role, converted-helper, regional-clone or emission-origin certification.
Unreached upstream production, venting/flaring, LNG and refinery-specific inputs require boundary-specific treatment; do not replace all of them with delivered-fuel mixes.
Fixed 4% and 15% ETBE petrol grades remain dedicated source recipes; changing them to an unspecified IAM average would lose their grade definition.
Retaining every source code proves record retention, not unchanged coefficients or completeness of source biosphere flows.
